scripts.dev: trap 'kill 0' EXIT; node server.mjs & npm --prefix web run dev
scripts.app:dev: npm run build && npm --prefix app run sidecar && . ~/.cargo/env && npm --prefix app run tauri dev
scripts.app:build: if pgrep -qf 'wt-dashboard.app/Contents/MacOS/wt-dashboard'; then echo 'wt-dashboard is running: quit it (tray > Quit) before rebuilding the .app' >&2; exit 1; fi; npm run build && npm --prefix app run sidecar && . ~/.cargo/env && npm --prefix app run tauri build
